title: Implement core logic for kernel computation using relator lifts
description: Implement the mathematical core for computing the kernel of a surjective homomorphism between FpGroups. For a surjective homomorphism φ: G → H where G and H are FpGroups, the kernel is generated by lifts of H's relators. The implementation should: (1) Iterate through the relators of the codomain FpGroup, (2) Use the `invert` method to compute the lift (preimage) of each relator in the domain, (3) Collect these lifts as generators for the kernel, (4) Return an FpSubgroup generated by these lifts with normal=True. This approach works for both finite and infinite groups since it doesn't require computing orders.
expected_output: The core algorithm logic as Python code that computes kernel generators from relator lifts, suitable for integration into the _compute_kernel method.
